question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom/phrase.**

Break in
solution:
Here the correct answer is **Enter a building illegally.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of the given phrase:-
 
• **Break in** - to enter a building by force, especially in order to steal things. (किसी इमारत में बलपूर्वक प्रवेश करना, विशेष रूप से चीजों को चुराने के लिए)
 
 
• For Example - Someone had **broken in** through the bedroom window.
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1.**
